title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Can non Muslim visits Makkah and Madina? 6007 views Q. By the Mercy and Grace of Allah, i offer five times salat daily with jammat, i have a beared, wear topi, enjoin tableeghi jamaats and try to follow as much sunnahs as i can, but never have i ever been blessed with the sight of rasulallah in a dream. I sometimes hear about some people who have just started practicing the deen and that too for a few weeks or so and in couple of weeks he is blessed with such a blissful sight, and to me many years have passed and i havent had such a dream. I do not mean that its my right to see the prophit of Allah in my dream or that i deserve it, on the contrary i feel i am quite a sinful person, but i want to ask 1) is there something that i am missing in my ibadaats or ikhlaas? do i have to do dua or wazeefa for it? 2)Does seing the prophit in the dream means that a person will be righteous through out his life? because i have seen people who have had the privelege of a such dream but they now rarely offer salat. 3) is it so that every pious person sees the prophit peace be upon him in dream? Does every alim, mufti, sheikh sees him in his or her dream? 1469 views Q. I am an employee of autonomous body and very busy with my job. I am living in developing new residential area since last 10 years. As per requirement the construction of a new masjid became necessary in our locality. For which a committe was formed and I become an office bearer of the masjid committee. I involve myself only for the cause of that all the constuction work of the masjid should be done as per the shari'a i.e. avoiding haram funds and materials. As I am very busy with my job and I offer daily five salat anywhere or in the house if the jama'at times over. Since I am not punctual to attend that local masjid to offer all five salat, hence some musalliyan are blaming me for the "khokli seerat" and say that "ta'ajjub hai aap ghar per namaz pade aur masjid doosron ke liye banaye". On continuous blaming by the musalliyan, now I want to leave membership from the masjid committee. Whereas 40% work of the constuction is remain to complete. And no other member look after the work carefully and maintain the shara'i oosool. May I leave this as majority of muslliyan dislike me? answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 11190 Country: India Title: i often see my mamujaan SYED FAREED AHMED who was a excellent humanbeing n expired in a car accident i see him in my dream very often n i seethat we r sitting in a gathering with all the family members and his soulis also there but only i can see him and i offer salam to him and he keeps his hand on my cheek as a reply n smiles back like he use to do whan he was alive i often see this deram too pls tell me the tabeer of this deam Question: i often see my mamujaan SYED FAREED AHMED who was a excellent humanbeing n expired in a car accident i see him in my dream very often n i seethat we r sitting in a gathering with all the family members and his soulis also there but only i can see him and i offer salam to him and he keeps his hand on my cheek as a reply n smiles back like he use to do whan he was alive i often see this deram too pls tell me the tabeer of this deam Answer ID: 11190 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 351/300=D/1430) The condition of your maternal uncle is good after death. It is blessed dream. But, you have been alerted not to be neglectful towards the hereafter and to do good deeds, shun bad deeds and make preparation for the hereafter. Also, you should sometime do isal-e-thawab for him by charity, tilawah and dhikr . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
